[TAHITI/AOU Table2-Gold] Choices[1] repurposed from TokenHulk to AvengersMysteryBox - a single box that yields one character OR one costume, replacing the three hardcoded character tokens (Hulk/Deadpool/Emma Frost) that dropped together and guaranteed on every qualifying clear. Choices[2] and [3] are zeroed out below rather than deleted: LootDropItemPrototype.Roll() derives numItems from NumMin/NumMax and RollItem() returns NoRoll below 1, so this removes them without shifting the array indices the Choices[0].* patches rely on. Kept at 100% deliberately - reaching Phase 4 Gold on Ultron is the gate, not a dice roll. The T3/T4/T5 restriction already lives on this table's own Modifiers[] entry.

[TAHITI/AOU Table3-Gold] Disable placeholder choice[0] - Entity/Items/Test/TestThrowArtifact.prototype, a developer test artifact with no real value. LootDropItemPrototype.Roll() computes numItems from NumMin/NumMax and RollItem() returns NoRoll when that is < 1, so zeroing both removes the drop without shifting array indices (the Choices[1].* patches for the real reward depend on those indices holding). Choice[1] - Insignia x5 with SetRarity(R4Epic)/LevelOffset 6 - is deliberately kept: that is the actual Phase-4-Gold capstone reward.
